scale.name: All clear
scale.notice: No smoke to notice. Sky looks normal. You can see 10+ miles.
scale.notLine: No smoke story today. This is normal, clean air.

guidance.general: it's a great day to be active outside.
guidance.sensitive: it's a great day to be active outside.

scale.name: In the air
scale.notice: A faint campfire whiff for sensitive noses. Most people just see distant treelines go soft, roughly 5 to 10 miles of visibility.
scale.notLine: A faint whiff is the whole event for most people. Nothing here needs a change of plan.

guidance.general: unusually sensitive people should consider easing off long, hard exertion. Everyone else, carry on as usual.
guidance.sensitive: consider easing off long or hard exertion, and watch for symptoms.

scale.name: Smells like fire
scale.notice: Most people smell smoke outdoors, though not everyone. The sun can look orange at the edges, and visibility drops to roughly 3 to 5 miles. Long stretches outside may leave a scratchy throat.
scale.notLine: Most people notice it outdoors, and most plans can carry on. Long stretches outside are where it starts to add up.

guidance.general: sensitive groups should cut back on long or heavy exertion. Everyone else, your usual outdoor plans are okay.
guidance.sensitive: cut back on long or heavy exertion. Move the workout indoors if there is any wheeze.

scale.name: Tastes like fire
scale.notice: Smoke often reaches indoors near windows. Eyes can sting. Visibility runs roughly 1.5 to 3 miles. A full day breathing this is on the order of smoking a few cigarettes.
scale.notLine: Now it adds up: a full day breathing this is on the order of a few cigarettes. Worth moving the run indoors.

guidance.general: sensitive groups should avoid prolonged exertion; everyone else, cut back on it.
guidance.sensitive: avoid prolonged exertion. Keep inhalers close; indoors with filtration is the good call.

scale.name: Smokeshow
scale.notice: Visibility under about 1.5 miles. Everything smells like a doused campfire, and fine ash is possible. Everyone inside, windows closed, run filtration if you have it.
scale.notLine: The heaviest level we track. Everyone inside, windows closed, filtration on if you have it.

guidance.sensitive: stay inside, windows closed, filtration on. This level is for no one.

verdict.headline: Stays clear for the next 5 days

agreement.label: Single-model forecast. Confidence fades past 36 hours.
